title: Provenance
description: Origin of the image, required so AI provenance (EU AI Act art. 50) survives the brand -> retailer -> shop chain.

ai_generated.description: True when the image is (mostly) generated by AI. A publisher that knows this MUST say so.

ai_edited.description: True when a real photo was materially edited with generative AI (e.g. background, model, garment fit).

source.description: photo: camera original (possibly retouched); generated: synthesised; composite: photo combined with generated parts.

c2pa.description: Where C2PA Content Credentials live. embedded: inside the original bytes (preserved: originals are served unmodified).

anyOf.description: Sidecar manifest URL (when c2pa is sidecar).
